claims.text: Named Entity Recognition (NER) involves the identification of entities such as proteins, genes, diseases, treatments, and drugs in text.
NER in the biomedical domain faces unique challenges compared to general text due to the complexity of biomedical terminology.
Recent advancements in NER include the use of deep learning techniques, such as recurrent neural networks, to improve performance.
NER is a key task within Biomedical Information Extraction, which applies Natural Language Processing techniques to extract relevant information from biomedical texts.
